description: MCP tool surface. Each tool is a CommandType. inputSchema mirrors /schemas.

tools.name: aether_identity_register
tools.description: Register an agent identity, DID, Ed25519 key, and cash account.

tools.name: aether_identity_freeze
tools.description: Freeze an agent: autonomy drops to L0, spend denied. Unfreeze restores the prior rung.

tools.name: aether_identity_unfreeze
tools.description: Lift a freeze. Counts as a kill-switch test required before L5.

tools.name: aether_mandate_issue_intent
tools.description: Issue a signed open or closed intent mandate with constraints. An execution_date window that has already closed, or that opens after the slip dies, is refused. A recurrence cap that cannot admit a first hire is refused. A child of an expired parent is refused.

tools.name: aether_mandate_issue_cart
tools.description: Issue a merchant-bound cart hashed to an intent. Completing a funded hire after the cart window is legal; fund of a stale cart is not.

tools.name: aether_mandate_issue_payment
tools.description: Issue a payment mandate whose transaction_id is sha256(cart). A cart takes one payment; inspect of that cart then labels bound.

tools.name: aether_market_rfq
tools.description: Create an RFQ. Non-empty invitedSellerIds is a closed room of live agents; empty/omitted is open. A missing guest is identity.known.

tools.name: aether_market_quote
tools.description: Submit a quote or FX rate. MM rates must stay inside 200bps. An FX validUntil already past or unparseable is refused.

tools.name: aether_hire_create
tools.description: Offer a hire contract with an escrow account. Requires L3+ against an existing intent. A nested hop whose parent handshake has expired is refused. An expired handshake, a climb above the handshake ceiling, or a climb above the slip ceiling is refused on a new hire. A hot settle hour pauses a new hire for a grown-up. Completing funded work after that is legal.

tools.name: aether_hire_accept
tools.description: Seller accepts a hire. Escrow must already exist. Accept is not a spend; a hot settle hour does not pause it.

tools.name: aether_hire_fund
tools.description: Buyer funds escrow. Budget is consumed here, not at deliver/submit. A nested hop whose parent handshake has expired is refused. An expired handshake, a climb above the handshake ceiling, or a climb above the slip ceiling is refused on a new fund. A hot settle hour pauses a new fund for a grown-up. Completing funded work after that is legal.

tools.name: aether_hire_deliver
tools.description: Seller marks work delivered. Hire must be funded. Completing after the cart, handshake, grant, or a hot settle hour is legal.

tools.name: aether_hire_refund
tools.description: Unwind funded escrow to the buyer. Restores mandate spend. Circuit stays sticky. Not after deliver/release. Completing after the cart, handshake, grant, or a hot settle hour is legal; freeze and revoke still bind.

tools.name: aether_hire_release
tools.description: Release funded+delivered escrow to the seller without an x402 envelope. Same books as envelope.submit. Completing after the cart, handshake, grant, or a hot settle hour is legal; freeze and revoke still bind.

tools.name: aether_payment_require
tools.description: Return an x402-shaped PaymentRequired envelope (HTTP 402).

tools.name: aether_payment_submit
tools.description: Submit a signed PaymentPayload. Settles via sim facilitator. Completing after the cart, handshake, grant, or a hot settle hour is legal; hashes still verify. Freeze and revoke still bind.

tools.name: aether_approval_resolve
tools.description: Approve or reject an escalation ticket. Replay uses commandHash.

tools.name: aether_kya_attest
tools.description: Issue a Know-Your-Agent handshake: principal → delegate, revocable, depth-capped. expiresAt must be after now and at most one year; omit for one year. A nested hop under an expired or revoked parent is refused.

tools.name: aether_kya_revoke
tools.description: Revoke a handshake. Cascades to sub-delegates. Blocks implicit supervisor grants.

tools.name: aether_circuit_reset
tools.description: Reset a tripped daily circuit breaker. Mandate budgets are unchanged.

tools.name: aether_ladder_set
tools.description: Move an agent one rung. Skipping rungs is illegal. any→L0 always allowed.

tools.name: aether_clearing_settle_window
tools.description: Close a settlement window: archive net exposure for a currency. Money already moved at escrow.

tools.name: aether_ledger_balances
tools.description: Read account balances. Does not mutate.

tools.name: aether_audit_verify
tools.description: Replay the hash-chained audit log from genesis.

tools.name: aether_audit_query
tools.description: Read notary lines for one subject id (hire, mandate, quote, agent). Does not mutate.

tools.name: aether_market_catalog
tools.description: List SKUs that may be hired. This is not a storefront. A hot settle hour is not a spend.

tools.name: aether_receipt_get
tools.description: Fetch a receipt. reference must equal sha256(payment mandate).

tools.name: aether_demo_sprint
tools.description: Run the Sprint Procurement TAP demo on sim:aether-1.

tools.name: aether_demo_night_watch
tools.description: Run the Night Watch standing-mandate TAP demo: KYA, L5, circuit, freeze, revoke.

tools.name: aether_demo_sub_hire
tools.description: Run the L4 sub-intent TAP demo: nested slips, parent budget, revoke child handshake.
